title: Too many unprocessed floats on Mac (add \clearpage between runs of figures)
short_title: LaTeX says Too many unprocessed floats? Add \clearpage

runs.cmd: cd "$(mktemp -d)" && { print -rl -- '\documentclass{article}' '\begin{document}' 'Results.'; for i in {1..60}; do print -r -- "\begin{figure}[htbp]\rule{2cm}{1cm}\caption{Figure $i}\end{figure}"; done; print -r -- '\end{document}'; } > main.tex && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex > out.txt; grep -m1 '^! LaTeX' out.txt; grep -c 'begin{figure}' main.tex
runs.output:
! LaTeX Error: Too many unprocessed floats.
60

runs.cmd: cd "$(mktemp -d)" && { print -rl -- '\documentclass{article}' '\begin{document}' 'Results.'; for i in {1..60}; do print -r -- "\begin{figure}[htbp]\rule{2cm}{1cm}\caption{Figure $i}\end{figure}"; [ "$i" = 20 -o "$i" = 40 ] && print -r -- '\clearpage'; done; print -r -- '\end{document}'; } > main.tex && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex > out.txt; grep -c 'clearpage' main.tex; grep -c '^!' out.txt; grep 'Output written' out.txt
runs.output:
2
0
Output written on main.pdf (9 pages, 17971 bytes).

verify.notes: Each run writes a small article in a fresh temporary folder with sixty figure environments in a row and no text between them, every one marked [htbp], and builds it once with pdfLaTeX from TeX Live 2026. Without \clearpage the build stops with Too many unprocessed floats: figures wait in a queue for a page break, and the current kernel holds 52 of them. With \clearpage after figure 20 and figure 40 the queue is emptied twice, the build reports no errors and writes a 9 page PDF. Changing the placement options alone, to [htbp], does not help, which the first run shows.

scenes.title: Too many unprocessed floats
scenes.sub: Your figures are waiting for a page that never comes.
scenes.narration: If LaTeX stops with too many unprocessed floats, the problem is not one figure. It is the queue they wait in.

scenes.label: Terminal
lines: ! LaTeX Error: Too many unprocessed floats.
scenes.narration: Here is the error. This chapter has sixty figures in a row, with no text between them, and every one already says h t b p.

scenes.text: LaTeX holds each figure in a queue until a page break gives it a place. With no text between figures, no page breaks, and the queue fills up.
scenes.narration: LaTeX does not place a figure the moment it reads it. It holds it in a queue until a page ends and there is room. With figure after figure and no text, the page never ends, and once the queue is full, the build stops.

scenes.label: main.tex
lines: Add \clearpage after every 20 or so figures
Or put some text between long runs of figures
scenes.narration: Add a clear page command after every twenty or so figures. It ends the page and sets every waiting figure before going on. Text between the figures helps too. Then build again.

scenes.label: Terminal
lines: Output written on main.pdf (9 pages, 17971 bytes).
scenes.narration: With two clear page commands, the same sixty figures build with no errors, and the PDF has nine pages.

scenes.name: ModernTex
scenes.line: Translates LaTeX build errors into plain explanations with a suggested fix, and marks them in the editor.
scenes.narration: If you write LaTeX on a Mac, ModernTex translates build errors into plain explanations with a suggested fix, and marks them in the editor.
